question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words.**

In exactly the same words as were used originally
solution: The correct answer is **"Verbatim."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Verbatim"** means exactly as it was spoken or written. (जैसा बोला या लिखा गया ठीक वैसा; शब्‍दशः) • **Example:***** **I don’t think I will read the whole thing **verbatim**__ to you.* • It is an adverb and can be used to describe how something is being repeated or quoted. • So, the correct answer is **option 2**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **"Misanthrope"** means a person who dislikes humankind and avoids human society. (मनुष्य से घृणा करनेवाला; मानवद्वेषी) • **'Kennel"** means a shelter or a house for a dog or a group of dogs. (छोटा कुत्ताघ, कुक्‍कुरशाला) • **"Lunatic"** means a person who is mentally ill or unstable. (पागलपन का आचरण करने वाला व्‍यकि्त) 3f:Td1a, The correct answer is **"Assertive."**
